# mabinogi-014 — establishment log (2026-11-15)

Evans 1907 cols 101 l. 17 – 111 l. 16 (PDF pp. 83–88). Every column read on the page image (zoom 4, three crops per
column; zoom 12–14 for single lines). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate
disagreements and for punctuation, word division and paragraph shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w;
r-rotunda → r; ſ → s; raised letters into the line; letters Evans prints with a single dot beneath (the scribe's
expunction) left out; line-end marks, Evans's dotted/wavy underlines and the "!"-like line marks dropped. Red Book =
Rhŷs & Evans 1905 (source/raw/rhys-evans1905_djvu.txt), consulted for the items marked RB.

Tooling note: page 83/85/87 cols at x ≈ 0–124 / 108–230; page 84/86/88 x ≈ 93–217 / 203–335. Text y ≈ 40–405.
PyMuPDF must be installed with `python3 -m pip install pymupdf` (plain `pip` installs into another Python here).

## Opening and close
- col 101 l. 17 — the part begins mid-line after 013's "… ac y arglwydiaeth.": "Ac yna treigylgueith …". No large initial.
- Close: col 111 l. 16 "Ac yuelly y teruyna y geing honn o'r mabinogi." (the end of the Fourth Branch; col 111 is a
  short column, col 112 empty).

## Worklist items (46 check + 25 loss), decided on the image
OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the image agrees with the witness: col 101 ll. 22, 24 (llyma); col 102 ll. 10
(kennadeu), 21, 27, 29, 30; col 103 ll. 11, 21, 25, 31; col 104 ll. 9 (ac ef), 25, 27 (see below); col 105 ll. 9, 10,
13, 14 (see below), 27, 29, 35 (y uwrw); col 106 ll. 9, 11 (gwreskyn), 15, 17, 29; col 107 ll. 5, 10, 13, 18, 19,
29, 30 (see below), 31; col 108 ll. 4, 8–9 (see below), 15 (see below), 18 (ar lin), 19 (see below), 31; col 109 ll.
1, 7 (see below), 18, 19, 25, 34 (see below); col 110 ll. 9, 17, 23 (see below), 26, 36; col 111 ll. 1, 3, 9, 10, 11
(see below).

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 101 l. 22 — **"troi o uywn y llys a wnaet hi"**: Evans *a6naet hi*, no h (zoom 4, clear). RB *a wnaeth hi*.
  Kept as written (the h of *wnaeth* lost before *hi*). NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 102 l. 6 — **"o'e ady y prytwn"**: Evans *oe adẏ* (zoom 12). Witness and RB *adu*. Kept; NOTE FOR DRAFTER
  (for *adu* 'leave', gadu).
- col 102 l. 11 — **"y kymerth ef wahawd"**: no *y* in Evans; the witness's [y] is the RB's (*y kymerth ef y wahawd*).
  Not supplied (the sense stands). NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 102 l. 15 — **"Arglwydes, Duw a dalho it dy lywenyd."**: no *heb ef*; the witness's [heb ef] is the RB's. Not supplied.
- col 104 l. 22 — **"wedy hynny hyhitheu"**: Evans *6edẏ*, witness *wedi*. Evans *hẏ hitheu* in two words; written
  *hyhitheu* with the witness. (RB *ac yndidos 6edy hynny*, without *hyhitheu*.)
- col 104 l. 27 — **"uy agheu"**: Evans *ag-heu* (no n), witness *angheu*. The scribe's g for ng (as in *chyghoraf*,
  col 103). Kept.
- col 105 l. 2 — **"pa delw y gallei uot yn hynn a dywedeisti"**: Evans *ẏn hẏnn* certain at zoom 12; witness *yr hynn*;
  RB *uot yn wir a dywedeist*. Kept; NOTE FOR DRAFTER: *yn hynn* is probably a slip for *yr hynn* ('that which'), or
  half of the RB's *yn wir* ('be true') — say the reading is uncertain.
- col 105 l. 9 — **"Y glan Auon Kynuael oed hynny."**: Evans *ẏglan*; written *y glan* as in 007 (yg/ym written y).
- col 105 l. 14 — **"o'r parth draw y auon"**: Evans *dza6 ẏ auon* — *y*, not *y'r* (witness). RB *y: auon* (yr). Kept;
  'to the river' without the article. Also *a Bryn Kyuergyr* (single n here, *Brynn* elsewhere), as printed.
- col 107 l. 2 — **"ac ni wybydir"**: Evans *ni*, witness *ny*.
- col 107 l. 30 — **"ym blaen"**: Evans prints *blen* with a raised a over it; raised letter into the line → *blaen*.
- col 108 ll. 8–9 — second englyn: **"Nis gwlych glaw, nis mwy tawd. Naw ugein angerd a borthes."** Evans *nis gl6ẏch
  gla6 nis m6ẏ ta6d. na6 ugein angerd*. The witness's "mwy tawd nawes. Ugein angerd" is not on the page; RB agrees
  with Evans (*nys m6 y ta6d. na6 ugein angerd*). NOTE FOR DRAFTER: the line is obscure; say so.
- col 108 l. 15 — third englyn: **"Mirein medur"** (witness *modur*); RB *medur*. NOTE FOR DRAFTER (*medur* = modur
  'ruler'? uncertain).
- col 108 l. 16 — **"Ony dywedaf i, ef dydau Lleu y'm arfet."**: no *eu* in Evans; the witness's [eu] is not supplied
  (RB has none either). NOTE FOR DRAFTER: the line is short of the formula of the first englyn.
- col 108 l. 19 — **"a'r hutlath"**: Evans *hutlath* (t), witness *hudlath*; RB *hutlath* too. Kept (as in 012).
- col 108 l. 29 — **"Kyn kyuyl y'r ulwydyn"**: Evans *ẏz*; written *y'r* with the witness (RB *y2*); the drafter may
  read *yr* 'the' — NOTE FOR DRAFTER, as for *y'r dyd* in 012.
- col 109 l. 34 — **"yngynnatau"**: Evans *ẏngẏnnatau* (n, zoom 12); witness *ymgynnatau*, RB *ymgennattau*. Kept;
  NOTE FOR DRAFTER (ym- written yn- before g).
- col 111 l. 11 — **"ac a'y gwledychwys"**: Evans prints a raised a after *ac* (*ac ᵃẏ g6ledẏch6ẏs*, zoom 14); into the
  line → *ac a'y gwledychwys* ('and ruled it', *y* f. for *gwlat*, unmutated). Witness *ac y gwledychwys*. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.

Expunged letters (dot beneath; left out):
- col 103 l. 10 — **"Dioer, ni chyghoraf"**: Evans *niṭ*, the t dotted (zoom 12) → *ni* (witness agrees).
- col 110 l. 23 — **"Ac yna y seui Gronwy Bebyr"**: Evans *ẏſeuiṭ*, the t dotted → *seui* (witness agrees; RB *yseuif*).

Dot beneath a letter, NOT treated as expunction:
- col 104 l. 36 — **"guybot hynny"**: Evans *guẏbọt*, a dot beneath the o (zoom 12). Leaving the o out gives no word;
  kept *guybot* (RB *g6ybot*). Uncertain what the dot marks; recorded in QUESTIONS.md.

Raised letters into the line: col 103 l. 11 *canys* (raised s); col 107 l. 30 *blaen* (raised a); col 111 l. 11 *a'y*
(raised a). Suspension stroke over *Trannoeth* (col 103 l. 9) dropped (the word is written in full).

Marks, not letters: the "!"-like mark at the line end in col 105 l. 13 (after *parth*), col 109 l. 7 (after *Gynuael*),
col 111 l. 3 (after *ynteu*) — dropped (as in 010, 011, 013).

Scribal forms kept as written (readable; for the drafter's notes):
- *Caer Dathyl* / *Caer Tathyl* (col 101), *Blodeued* (col 102) / *Blodeuwed* (cols 109), *Gronw* / *Gronwy*,
  *Pebyr* / *Bebyr*, *Lleu* (englynion) / *Llew* (narrative), *Auon Gynnwael* (col 101) / *Kynuael* / *Gynuael*.
- *Enteu* (col 103) for *Ynteu*; *chyghoraf*, *agheu* (g for ng); *y'm byrhit*; *uyghof*; *gyr llaw*; *Ba ryw*.
- *Nantllew* written as one word (Evans *nantlle6*); *Trymuryt* with the witness (Evans *Tzẏm urẏt*); *ymellwng* with
  the witness (Evans *ẏm ell6ng* once); *anhygar* (Evans *an hẏgar*); *Yn gyn gyflymet* (Evans one word).
- col 110 — *ban i'm byryawd*: Evans *im*; written *i'm* (the preverbal y + infixed 'm; RB *pan ym*).
- col 107 l. 4 — *yrof i* (Evans *ẏrofi*), divided as in 001.

Not supplied: [y] before *wahawd* (col 102), [heb ef] (col 102), [ac ef] after *y gyt* (col 107), [eu] in the third
englyn (col 108). No words supplied; no blanks in the White Book here.
